Bennett is MSU’s vice president and chief inclusion officer. Bennett, in concert with staff in the Office for Inclusive Excellence and Impact, works to advance MSU’s strategic priorities in access, opportunity and excellence and grow partnerships among senior executives, deans, faculty, staff, students and alumni. Bennett is also a professor of medicine in the College of Human Medicine. Shaw Lane, East Lansing, MI 48825 (517) 353-6486 ksc@msu.edu Biography Kendra Cheruvelil is a professor in the Department of Fisheries and Wildlife and Lyman Briggs College. She is co-director of the Bridge Lab, and she conducts big-data research on lakes to understand how global climate change and land use intensification affect lakes across regions and continents.
